subject: Post-demo: RTBF & backup residency follow-ups
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@finsecure.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: RTBF & backup residency follow-ups

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on your RTBF/delete requirements and backup constraints: 

Summary of what we heard:
- You need API-level deletion (user-triggered) with a guarantee that PII is removed from active stores within 24 hours of a successful delete call.
- Backups are retained for 30 days in S3 snapshots; deletion from backups requires a separate purge window / documented exception.
- Data residency: customer data must remain in US-only regions; no cross-region replication for regulated datasets.
- Auditability: you require immutable audit logs for delete requests (who/when) with 7-year retention for compliance.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a concise RTBF playbook (redwood-rtbf-playbook.pdf) that maps our delete API, backup behavior, and audit log exports. Please review the backup purge notes on page 3.
2) Can you confirm whether your legal team will accept a documented backup purge schedule (we propose an admin-initiated purge within 45 days of request for air-gapped snapshots) or if you need immediate exhaustion of backups?
3) We'll schedule a 30-minute follow-up with our security lead (Markus) to validate logging formats and KMS/HSM key separation for US-only keys. Are you available Thursday or Friday morning PST?

If anything above is off, tell me now and I'll correct. Otherwise I'll loop in Markus and propose two slots.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

Attachment: redwood-rtbf-playbook.pdf (PDF, 8 pages)
From: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@finsecure.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@finsecure.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: RTBF & backup residency follow-ups

Connor —

Thanks for the clear recap and the playbook. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) Active deletion SLA: 24 hours is acceptable. We need a guaranteed confirmation webhook or async job id returned by your API so we can reconcile.
2) Backups: Our policy is that customer data must be removed from backups as soon as practical but we cannot accept a 45-day automatic purge without documented controls. We need a documented playbook and an option for an expedited manual purge (within 7 business days) for escalations.
3) Audit logs: The 7-year retention is correct, but we need to ensure logs do not contain plaintext PII. Will you provide redacted log streams and a hash-based tombstone?

Let's set the security sync. I'm available Friday 11am PST. Aaron is looped for any legal/security pushback.

—Maya
Maya Gupta
Head of Data Privacy | FinSecure, Inc.
maya.gupta@finsecure.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@finsecure.com>, Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@finsecure.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: RTBF & backup residency follow-ups

Great — thanks for the specifics, Maya. Short answers inline: 

1) Confirmation webhook/job id: yes — our delete API returns a job id and we can emit a webhook to your endpoint on status change. We'll include the job id and deletion timestamp in the webhook payload.

2) Backups: understood on the expedited purge. Our standard workflow is admin-initiated snapshot purge (45 days) but we support escalated purges. For escalations we need a signed RTBF request and an auth confirmation from your Security or Legal admin; then our SREs can target the snapshots for manual scrub/purge. Practical purge window for manual scrub is 5–10 business days depending on snapshot size and region. We can document an SLA of 7 business days for expedited purges for signed requests.

3) Audit logs: we do not log raw PII in audit streams. Logs contain operation metadata + a one-way hashed identifier (SHA-256 salted per-customer) so you can correlate deletes without exposing PII. Markus — can you confirm the log export format and KMS key separation?

Laura/Stephanie — I'll book Friday 11am PST with Maya/Aaron and include Markus for the security deep-dive.

Connor

---
Attachment: s3-backup-policy-summary.xlsx (XLSX, 2 sheets)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@finsecure.com>, Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@finsecure.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: RTBF & backup residency follow-ups

Connor / team / FinSecure —

Confirming the technical points: 
- Webhook payload: will include job_id, requestor (redacted id), timestamp, status (queued/in_progress/complete/failed) and a customer-scoped SHA-256 hash of the deleted resource id. No plaintext PII.
- Logs: delivered to your S3 bucket (US regions only) with server-side encryption using a customer-managed KMS key (we support CMKs). We will not replicate those logs outside US-only.
- Backups: snapshots are region-scoped; for manual purges we run a scrub that replaces PII blobs with tombstone markers and then re-snapshot to ensure no restoration path. The scrub process requires SRE window; typical turnaround is 3–7 business days for typical dataset sizes (<10 TB).

Action items I can own for the call Friday: share a short sample webhook JSON (redacted) and a one-page Annex describing the expedited purge workflow and who must sign the request.

Markus Klein
Director, Applied Security | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
From: Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@finsecure.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@finsecure.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: RTBF & backup residency follow-ups

Connor / Markus —

Thanks for the detail. Friday 11am PST works. Two quick points before the call so Markus can prepare: 
1) Please bring the sample webhook payload and an example hashed id mapping workflow. We need to confirm the salt rotation policy.
2) For the expedited purge SLA (7 business days), we expect a written runbook that lists required approvals and contact points; having that annex before contract signature will be required for our procurement.

We'll be prepared to sign the expedited purge acceptance form during procurement if the runbook and KMS separation match our needs. See you Friday.

Aaron Cole
CISO | FinSecure, Inc.
aaron.cole@finsecure.com
